name: password-field
pattern: A password field composed of a native password input and a visibility toggle button
responsibility: Provides password visibility, ARIA, focus and selection restoration, form lifecycle handling, and state outputs. Does not generate appearance, elements, or content.

targets.input: Exactly one native <input type="password"> with data-password-field-target="input" inside the root
targets.toggle: Exactly one native <button type="button"> with data-password-field-target="toggle" inside the root

authorMarkup.label: The consumer supplies the input label. If the toggle has no nonempty aria-label, aria-labelledby, or text content, the controller supplies aria-label.
authorMarkup.validity: Valid markup has exactly one input target and one toggle target in a root. Violations disable enhancement for the entire controller (contractValidation.invalidMarkup). Neither target is enhanced independently.
authorMarkup.dynamicChanges: Stimulus TargetConnected/TargetDisconnected handles input and toggle addition, removal, and replacement. Direct changes to the accessible name or form owner of an already connected target are outside the guarantee.
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate elements or content.

semanticElements: Exactly one native <input> target with type password or text is required. Text is allowed because a visible controller can disconnect and reconnect while the input remains type="text".
Exactly one native <button type="button"> toggle target is required. Omitting type would make a button submit inside a form.
Not validated: the contents of show/hide labels and the input accessible name, which the library cannot infer.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate on connection and target changes. Invalid markup prevents type, attribute, and state writes; leaves toggle and form listeners unregistered; makes the visible setter, show, hide, and toggle no-ops; and issues console.warn once per connection. Do not issue completion warnings. Ignore intermediate target-replacement states within one microtask. Reapply enhancement when markup becomes valid without repeating the warning. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Use the standard English disabling warning and include the expected markup: one native <input type="password"> input target and one native <button type="button"> toggle target.

completion.warning: List completed attributes using "Added <attributes>. Include them in your markup." Warn once per connection using a flag separate from the enhancement-disabling warning.

visible.description: Initial visibility: false means password; true means text.

showLabel.description: aria-label supplied by the controller while hidden

hideLabel.description: aria-label supplied by the controller while visible

visible.description: Current visibility. Assignment commits state without events or focus movement.

show().description: Makes the password visible without events or focus movement.

hide().description: Makes the password hidden without events or focus movement.

toggle().description: Toggles visibility without events or focus movement.

password-field:beforetoggle.when: Before a change caused by trusted pointer or keyboard activation
password-field:beforetoggle.effect: If preventDefault() is called, do not change state, send notifications, or change focus or selection through the controller.

password-field:toggle.when: After a change caused by trusted pointer or keyboard activation

events.programmatic: The visible setter, show(), hide(), toggle(), synthetic click, initialization, value changes, form submit, form reset, dynamic-target synchronization, and reconnection do not emit events.

visibility.hidden: When visible=false, set input type to password and root/toggle data-state to hidden.
visibility.visible: When visible=true, set input type to text and root/toggle data-state to visible.
visibility.initial: On connection, synchronize input type and state outputs from the visible value.
visibility.valuePreservation: Never change the input value when changing visibility.

activation.nativeButton: Use native <button type="button"> activation; do not add custom keyboard activation.
activation.pointer: Toggle with reason="pointer" when a trusted click has detail greater than zero.
activation.keyboard: Toggle with reason="keyboard" when a trusted click has detail zero.
activation.synthetic: Treat clicks with isTrusted=false as programmatic changes: toggle without events, focus movement, or selection restoration.
activation.disabled: Trusted activation is a no-op when the input or toggle is disabled. The public API may still change state.
activation.readonly: Allow activation and public API changes when the input is readonly.

focusAndSelection.pointer: Save the pre-change selection range when available, then focus the input and restore the range after commitment. Restore focus even if range operations fail.
focusAndSelection.canceled: The controller does not change focus or selection.
focusAndSelection.programmatic: Do not change focus or selection.

managedMarkup.inputId: Use ensureElementId to supply an ID unique within the same document only when the input has no ID. Preserve existing IDs.
managedMarkup.ariaControls: Supply the input ID as aria-controls only when the toggle lacks the attribute. Update controller-supplied values on input-target replacement. Preserve authored values.
managedMarkup.toggleAccessibleName: Supply aria-label at target connection only if no nonempty aria-label, aria-labelledby, or text content exists. Update it to showLabel while hidden and hideLabel while visible.
managedMarkup.stateOutputs: The controller owns input type and root/toggle data-state and synchronizes them with visible.

formLifecycle.association: Rebind listeners on input.form during connect() and input TargetConnected/TargetDisconnected. Direct changes to the form owner of the same connected input are outside the guarantee.
formLifecycle.submit: Return to hidden on associated-form submission without events or focus movement.
formLifecycle.reset: After native reset finishes, return to hidden in a task only if defaultPrevented=false, the controller remains connected, and the connection generation and form are unchanged.
formLifecycle.subscription: Remove listeners on disconnect() and input-target disconnection; do not duplicate them on reconnection or target replacement.

lifecycle: Activate toggle and form listeners in connect() and remove them in disconnect().
Leave generated attributes and state outputs in place on disconnect().
Synchronize with current targets and values on reconnection.
Handle target replacement through inputTargetConnected, inputTargetDisconnected, toggleTargetConnected, and toggleTargetDisconnected.
Do not throw when a target is temporarily absent.

observations.impact: Native password/text input behavior and the contract-defined toggle state are fixed independently of speech wording.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
The behavior and accessibility implemented by this component must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
The toggle is a named native button activatable with Enter and Space.
Preserve authored id, aria-label, aria-labelledby, text content, and aria-controls.
Keep visible, input type, root/toggle data-state, and controller-owned aria-label consistent across all change paths.
Restore input focus and any available selection after pointer activation; keep toggle focus after keyboard activation.
Canceling beforetoggle leaves state unchanged. Only committed trusted activation emits one toggle event.
Disabled trusted activation does nothing; readonly permits changes; synthetic and public API changes emit no events.
Form submission and uncanceled reset restore hidden state.
Disconnect/reconnect and target replacement do not duplicate listeners; events during disconnection have no effect.
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report real-device screen reader verification as unverified.
testMatrix: Initial state, public API, ARIA, generated IDs, and state synchronization
Trusted pointer and keyboard events, cancellation, focus, and selection
No events from synthetic click; disabled and readonly behavior
Form submit, reset, cancellation, and connection-generation guards
Disconnect/reconnect cleanup and dynamic target replacement

testMatrix.description: Missing completion attributes produce a warning once per connection; complete markup produces no warning.
Invalid markup warns once and disables enhancement; becoming valid reapplies enhancement without another warning.

negativeControls.guard: Synchronization of visible, input type, and root/toggle data-state

mutation.description: Remove root and toggle data-state updates.

negativeControls.expectedFailure: password-field-state-sync and other tests checking state synchronization fail. State output is a shared invariant, so multiple related tests fail.

mutation.description: Ignore the false return value of dispatchEvent().

negativeControls.guard: Toggle and form listener cleanup in disconnect()

negativeControls.plannedMutation: Disable the completion-warning condition so missing attributes no longer warn.

mutation.description: Make the completion-warning condition always return.
Remove semantic validation from reconcile() and continue enhancement with invalid markup.
